answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is progressive identity bonding: each new agent must lock a growing fraction of stake as a relic of commitment on a shared bridge of collateral. When a jury detects coordinated fake identities, a comet of slash events burns the attacker’s entire bonded stake across the cluster. This costs the attacker capital that scales with the number of identities while honest participants only bond once and earn from grading work.
